messages.subject: reactive conditional panels
parts:
Is there any plan to implement reactive paneling with in shiny. Such as a panel that can create n check boxes based on previous user input?

This might seem like a silly question given my lacking knowledge in CSS and HTML, but is this possible or does this go back to shiny only loading its UI once?

simple example

select input list where the user can select multiple inputs. Say each input keys to a data set with the same variables. Then n check boxes are created with the ability to turn the individual data sets off and on in a plot.

messages.subject: Re: reactive conditional panels
parts:
This sounds similar to the dynamic UI examples that I linked to in my reply to your question about slider max and min.

Dynamic UI example:
  http://glimmer.rstudio.com/winston/dynamic_ui/
Source code at:
  https://gist.github.com/4211337

Tutorial page:
  http://rstudio.github.com/shiny/tutorial/#dynamic-ui


Although ui.r is run once, you can send pieces of user interface from server.r and insert them into the web page.

-Winston
